contenders.handicapper_notes: Brings the premier formline into this maiden after competing in strong Sydney midweek company at Canterbury behind Crescent King. Expensive yearling making her debut off an eye-catching trial victory at Rosehill on September 22 over 1050m. Looked very sharp on the engine and drew away under light riding from Kerrin McEvoy. Massive race fitness edge over the debutants and resumes with genuine peak form. Closed late to grab third beaten under a length over 1200m at Goulburn behind the highly regarded Centimetre.
